cluster of flat green pine trees positioned exclusively on the left side

reference_analysis.notes: The primary design is Image 1. Images 2 and 3 show variations in text, central mountain silhouette (Image 2 has a small building/structure added), and sun color (Image 3 is yellow). The design in Image 1 should be recreated exactly as shown. Note the consistent overall distressed texture applied to all elements, including the solid shapes and text.
reference_analysis.art_style: Vintage badge/logo design, flat vector illustration, distressed texture, minimalist rendering.
reference_analysis.composition: Circular badge layout. 'SUMMIT SEEKERS' arcs along the top inner edge of the circle. A rectangular black banner cuts across the bottom portion of the circle, extending slightly past the outer edge, containing the text 'SINCE 2005' centered in cream. The central mountain/sun/tree illustration is anchored on the horizontal line created by the top edge of the banner.
reference_analysis.subject_structure: A circular badge with a double outline (thin inner, thick outer). Inside, a large rust-red circle (sun/moon) serves as the backdrop. Overlapping the bottom half of the red circle are minimalist, solid black mountains with sharp, triangular peaks. In front of the mountains, on the left side, is a row of four stylized pine trees consisting of green stacked triangles and small black trunks. The entire design has an overall subtle distressed/speckled texture.
reference_analysis.typography_transcription: Bold, sans-serif, slightly condensed font for the arched top text. Solid, bold sans-serif font for the bottom banner text.
